address: Soembawastraat 63, Amsterdam (Montessori Lyceum Oostpoort at this address; the building carries a Valentijnschool sign): a 1932 Amsterdam School school of dark purple-brown brick, three storeys of cream-framed multi-pane windows under a deep cream cornice with an attic frieze of small windows and a hipped tile roof, a stone-framed entrance beside a tall stair window
notes: Soembawastraat 63 (BAG pand 0363100012080630, built 1932): OSM maps the Montessori Lyceum Oostpoort here; the building itself carries a Valentijnschool sign (w02-283, 2018), an Amsterdam School building of dark purple-brown brick, three storeys of cream-framed multi-pane windows under a deep cream cornice with an attic frieze of small windows and a hipped tile roof. walls[0] = west front (panel 4, surface 6): entrance in a stone portal, VALENTIJNSCHOOL sign; walls[1] = north front (panel 12, surface 17, w01-13).
Simplified: the oval sign plate, the stair window at the left edge, the attic frieze (three real window pitches 6/9/12 averaged to ten bays); the south and east walls (party and court) stay blank.
